name: Kisaku-tachi
source:
Royal Family Fitness Club
It's a high class fitness club for celebrities attended not only by idols, actresses and professional sports' athletes but even by important persons of the financial world.
That place, where are admitted as its members only chosen persons, is the hunting ground of men that push forward the "brute way".

Source: http://www.empress-game.com/Deceiver_and_kisaku/
translation:
皇室健身俱乐部

这是一家面向名人的高级健身俱乐部，来此锻炼的不只有偶像、女演员和职业运动员，甚至还有金融界要人。

这处只接纳获选者成为会员的场所，是那些奉行“蛮横之道”的男人们的狩猎场。

来源：http://www.empress-game.com/Deceiver_and_kisaku/
